_comment: Shared client/server cases for the #902/#918 observer credit. Read by cmd/server/observer_credit_test.go and test-issue-918-observer-credit-parity.js. Ages are seconds before 'now'; a negative observerAgoSec is in the future. 'status' is the three-state bucket (healthy/degraded/silent). 'observerRoster' (inactive|blacklisted) marks an observer row the database holds but /api/observers does not serve (soft-deleted, or in observerBlacklist): the client never sees it, so it gives no credit. The Go test runs every case through the real /api/observers, /api/nodes/network-status and /api/analytics/areas.

observer reported 10 min ago lifts a degraded companion
